title: Input matched multisignal colocalization clarifies regulatory assignments at primary biliary cholangitis loci
description: Open research compendium and npj Genomic Medicine submission candidate for PBC-wide screening followed by source-matched multi-signal reclassification of a prespecified high-information subset. The release separates variant-support and disease-statistic effects from residual reclassification, reports discovery and pair-conditional simulation channels, and adds bounded IL12RB2-NK evidence from a different FinnGen disease study system and a disease-eQTL/disease-caQTL/peak-gene chromatin triangle. It does not claim participant-level independence, direct eQTL-caQTL colocalization, causal mediation or general method superiority. R7C3C retains the unchanged R7C3B QiTeng/WPS editorial candidate and adds byte-audited asset catalogues; edited-version author approval and publisher proof are pending. This file is publication metadata, not proof that a Zenodo deposit exists.
